arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
sahihInternational: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
yusufAli: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
urdu: اور مجھے ان جھٹلانے والوں سے جو دولتمند ہیں سمجھ لینے دو اور ان کو تھوڑی سی مہلت دے دو

sahihInternational: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
yusufAli: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
urdu: تو تم کافروں کو مہلت دو بس چند روز ہی مہلت دو
